message:
How it reads now:
Leads sheet
Company (text, required), Contact (text), Email (email), Source (Referral, Inbound, Outbound or Event), Expected value a year (money), Owner (person, whoever adds it), Next follow-up (date), Notes (long text).

Steps
New → Contacted → Qualified → Proposal → Won or Lost

Who can see and do what
Wade Wilson and Dev Kumar see every lead, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Lead owners see their own leads and can add, edit and move them.
Everyone else sees nothing.

Connections
People fills Owner.

Later
A Contacts sheet for several people at one company
A reminder to the owner when a follow-up date arrives

Coming soon
Connections to other software

This chat so far:
Wade Wilson: How can I add a company sheet? Tell me the steps.
Bike: 1. Open Customize in Sales leads.

2. Ask here: "Add a Companies sheet with a Name, a Website and an Owner". Bike shows the new sheet and what changes for today's rows.

3. Check the plan, then click Apply. Nothing changes until you do.

4. To link leads to companies, ask here: "Pick the company on each lead from Companies instead of typing it". Bike matches each typed company to a company row and lists any it can't match before Apply.

Sales managers will see the new sheet, since they see every row. Lead owners won't see it until the Owner question on Companies is set, so the suggestion below adds it.

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Add a Companies sheet
